history.p: When Gade offered his third and last violin sonata to Breitkopf & Härtel he by mistake called it "Op. 62", the number he himself had already assigned to "Volkstänze" (NWGW 42).

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 12 staves. Two different paginations: 1-10 comprising the first and second movements, and 1-7 comprising the Finale. On p. 4 upside-down of this second gathering, a sketch for the Romanze and another one on a single folio with the heading "Romanze (2)" appear. In the upper left-hand margin on fol. 1.r in the first gathering dating and title: "10 Juni Sonate for / Violin & Piano." At the end of the first movement dated "9 & 10 Juni 1885". In the right-hand margin of p. 7 in the second gathering end-dated "23 / Juni / 1885".

physDesc.physMedium: 8 bifolios and 1 single folio. Written in ink. Paper: 12 staves. Paginated 1-33. Last page blank. In upper left-hand corner of p. 1 dated: "10 Juli / 1885." With minor corrections. At the bottom of p. 33 dated "10 Juli - 24 juli 1885. / Fredensborg".

3 bifolios and 1 single folio. Written in ink. Paginated 1-12½. Last page blank and unnumbered. The last five staves on p. 6 and all staves on p. 7 cancelled. At the end of the music on p. 12½ dated "St. Hansdag / 24 Juni / 1885" and Gade's musical signature.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 12 staves. Heading in upper right-hand corner on p. 1 "Sonate No 3. / Niels W Gade Op. 59" in Gade's hand. Tempo indications on pp. 1, 15, 24 and heading "Scherzo" on p. 24 also in Gade's hand. At the end of the music on p. 13 Gade has written: "Rev. von [Gade's musical signature]".
